principle: Maximize compatible evidence without pooling incompatible endpoints, treatments, tumors, or replication units.

egfr_spatial_resistance.pooling: state-level metadata only; no recurrence pooling

gist_rfs.pooling: compatible within this cohort; external GIST OS cohorts remain separate until endpoint harmonization

melanoma_braf_response.pooling: keep cBioPortal clinical response and GEO expression cohorts separate; patient-aware treatment-stratified validation pending

breast_treatment_response.pooling: breast genomic resistance cohorts without response fields remain context only

renal_trial_response.pooling: keep treatment arms and endpoint definitions within trial

pancreatic_trial_response.pooling: keep treatment arms and endpoint definitions within trial

excluded_pools: Do not sum cells or nuclei as patient samples.
Do not pool RFS, DFS, PFS, OS, response, and early resistance as one endpoint.
Do not pool different tumors into one clinical model.
Do not pool immunotherapy, EGFR-TKI, BRAF-TKI, CDK4/6, or chemotherapy response cohorts.
Do not call internal cross-validation external validation.
